title: Shenzhen Zhongning Technology Co., Ltd. | China Aerogel Manufacturer
content:
Shenzhen Zhongning Technology Co., Ltd. is a Chinese aerogel materials company focused on aerogel products, thermal-insulation systems, and application services across industrial, construction, energy-storage, and battery sectors. Its public site positions the company as a national-level specialized and sophisticated enterprise active in aerogel industrialization, standards participation, and large-scale commercial supply.

Company Overview

Zhongning promotes a broad aerogel solutions platform that spans industrial insulation, building energy saving, renewable-energy thermal protection, and raw-material and technology output. The company’s public materials emphasize both product supply and system-level application support for industrial equipment, public buildings, energy storage, and vehicle battery safety.

Coverage and Focus

  • Coverage Area: Mainland China with application and partner support across multiple industrial sectors.
  • Focus Areas: Industrial insulation, building energy efficiency, EV battery thermal protection, energy-storage safety, and aerogel technology output.

Main Products and Capacity

  • Aerogel insulation blankets and microporous insulation felt
  • Aerogel battery cell-to-cell thermal barriers
  • Aerogel powder, slurry, and coating systems
  • Aerogel composite non-combustible insulation boards
  • Public Capacity: 25,000 m³ of aerogel blankets, 1,100 tons of aerogel powder, 25,000 tons of aerogel coatings, and 100,000 m³ of aerogel composite non-combustible insulation boards annually.

Production Sites and Certifications

  • Main Production Sites: Public materials describe manufacturing bases in Central China and North China; the company brand and operating entity are based in Shenzhen, China.
  • International Certifications: Public pages highlight national specialized-enterprise recognition, standards participation, and patent strength; specific international certificate numbers are not clearly listed on the reviewed pages.
  • Official Website: http://www.agel-tech.com/
